provenance.source_name: USASpending.gov (Treasury, Bureau of the Fiscal Service)
provenance.geography_caveat: Awards are attributed to the recipient's location. Statewide programs paid to a state agency are counted in the county where that agency is located (Medicaid and SNAP concentrate in Ingham County), so a county figure is not federal spending on that county's residents.
provenance.program_bucket_caveat: Program buckets aggregate CFDA-numbered assistance only. Contract obligations without a CFDA number are inside the county total but in no bucket, so buckets do not sum to the total.
provenance.notes: Replaces the previous hand-seeded 20-county federal spending table. Missing figures are null, never 0.
